title.narrative: Preparedness and response support in WASH to Rohingya Refugees and Host Community in Cox's Bazar and Bashan Char

description.narrative: Objective:Reduce suffering, uphold human dignity, and save lives among conflict affected Rohingya refugees and the host community through WASH provisions.

Total in Target Group : 33721. The primary target group of the proposed project are the refugees, however, considering the mixed nature of the refugee settlements, the needs of vulnerable local residents are partly considered as well. As per government policy the portion of Host community will be 25% of the total beneficiaries.

WHH has been providing WASH provisions through a local partner in the Rohingya refugee camps 27 and 24 and adjuncts host communities at Teknaf since 2018 aiming to mitigate the most critical needs of Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH). But still, humanitarian needs remain at large particularly in the WASH sector in terms of construction, decommission, replacement, care & maintenance of WASH infrastructures, vector control, hygiene knowledge, and behavioral development in the area.
